verdict.rationale: DNSSEC is a fair question for an ICANN-accredited registrar, but nothing in the evidence mentions DNSSEC signing or DS record submission. The API docs cover DNS management only generally. The security page lists privacy, account lock, 2FA and Registry Lock, which are related controls, not DNSSEC.

support.subject: As a security engineer, DNSSEC is supported and easy — one-click or API-driven signing with the DS records handled at the registry
